newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar to supply set-top boxes to Spanish company.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar to supply set-top boxes to Spanish company.

text.p: EchoStar International Corp. said Monday it received a $40 million contract to provide set-top decoder boxes to the television unit of the Spanish Telefonica group of companies.

The subsidiary, Distribuidora de Television Digital S.A. (DTS), will launch its upcoming satellite television service throughout Spain in September. The link-up will use EchoStar digital boxes in combination with DTS's mini-satellite dishes.
DTS ordered 100,000 boxes for 1997, EchoStar said.
EchoStar also said it will license to DTS its proprietary electronic programming guide for use with the boxes.
EchoStar, based in Englewood, Colo., is a worldwide manufacturer and distributor of satellite television products.
EchoStar III, EchoStar's Lockheed Martin AX2100 satellite, is scheduled to launch from Cape Canaveral, Fla., on an Atlas IIAS launch vehicle in September.

The satellite will include programming complimentary to that offered by the DISH Network on EchoStar I and EchoStar II. The programming lineup could also include Internet delivery applications, and re-transmission of local channels to select large markets.
EchoStar stock rose 75 cents to $13.75 in late trading on Nasdaq.
